courses.title: The Way subscription
courses.description: Monthly or yearly access to the full path of guided sits and talks with Henry Shukman, after a free trial. Prices differ slightly by country through the app stores.

courses.title: Lifetime Subscription
courses.description: A single payment that gives permanent access to The Way, in place of an ongoing subscription.

courses.title: Rest and Renew: An Online Mini-Retreat with Henry Shukman and Kelly Boys
courses.description: Three live hours online: Henry leads a long sit in open, spacious awareness, Kelly Boys guides a lying-down deep-rest practice, and the two finish with conversation and questions.

courses.title: A 3-day residential retreat with Henry Shukman in the UK
courses.description: Three days at The Vedanta retreat centre in Lincolnshire with two daily sessions of guided sitting, talks, questions and walking practice, early silent sits and optional movement, and teaching assistants on hand. The teaching moves through the four areas the app is built on, namely mindfulness, support, flow and awakening.

courses.title: Practice support with Henry's Teaching Assistants
courses.description: Monthly online small-group sessions and bookable one-to-one calls with Luke Wientzen and Shana Smith, two long-time students of Henry, for questions about practice. Koan training is available with Shana, an assistant teacher in Sanbo Zen.
